correctness.rationale: Explicitly subtracting the three Kuramoto equations gives a two-dimensional autonomous relative-phase system. At every equilibrium sin(u)=sin(v), exhausting the coincident and complementary branches. The complementary branch has negative Laplacian trace (-2b) and is unstable; the coincident branch has exactly the two transverse decay rates 3a cos(phi) and a[cos(phi)+2q cos(2phi)]. Strict concavity of sin(phi)+q sin(2phi) on (0,pi/2) proves the exact fold, uniqueness of attracting lock, and excluded boundary. Differentiating the maximized normalized response proves strict onset monotonicity. The large-q implicit equation and eigenvalues prove g_p ~ 9K cos(phi_inf)/(2q). A two-end vanishing continuous positive gap establishes an attained finite optimizer in the crossing budget window. Symbolic checks and 400 direct Jacobian spectra passed; numerical tests do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: A fixed resource-budget detuned oscillator motif is a concrete small-network test of power-law coupling allocation. This theorem supplies complete exact all-exponent onset geometry and proves an opposing exponential deterioration in the slow transverse relaxation mode, producing a nontrivial attained finite exponent for rapid locking. It distinguishes existence costs from relaxation times without asserting a general large-network result.
